title: Drukschakelaar voor koffie/espresso regelen
text:
Dankzij het unieke, gepatenteerde systeem kan de CoEx®-brewer met één systeem koffie en espresso zetten. De druk is voor koffie en espresso verschillend; koffie wordt met een druk van 3 - 4 bar bereid, espresso met een druk van 9 bar.
Het volume van een consumptie is eenvoudig te wijzigen in de software-instellingen van de machine.
De contactduur tussen het water en het koffiepoeder is een heel belangrijke factor in de prestatie van de brewer en is voor koffie en espresso nagenoeg hetzelfde. De optimale contactduur tussen water en koffie is 15 - 25 seconden.
Om deze waarde te bereiken moet het systeem een restrictor gebruiken. Door de combinatie van hogere druk, lagere volume en een gelijke koffiecontactduur moet de uitstroom van espresso veel kleiner zijn dan de uitstroom van koffie. In de volgende afbeeldingen wordt de oplossing voor het maken van deze twee dranken in één systeem weergegeven.
1. Koffietoevoer Wanneer gekozen is voor koffie is de toevoer in het begin laag en wordt de drukschakelaar niet geactiveerd. (Veer is sterk genoeg om de drukschakelaar in de koffiestand te houden).
De koffie passeert de eerste restrictor en stroomt dan door de grote koffie-uitlaat.
2. Espressotoevoer Wanner gekozen is voor espresso dan is de toevoer eerst hoog en wordt de drukschakelaar geactiveerd. (Veer is niet sterk genoeg om de drukschakelaar in de koffiestand te houden).
De koffie-uitlaat wordt gesloten en de espresso moet door de tweede restrictie worden geperst, waardoor de toevoer wordt beperkt en de druk naar 9 bar wordt verhoogd.
Het drukverschil tussen koffie en espresso is alleen van toepassing op B2C-espressomachines. De CoEx® Fresh Brew- machines (zonder papieren filter) hebben geen veer om tussen koffie- of espresso-druk te schakelen.
De bovenzuiger heeft een gekleurde stip die verwijst naar de gatmaat/-maten en drukschakelaar.

title: Afdichtingen
text:
De brewer heeft twee zuigers; de bovenzuiger (beter bekend als filterkop) en de onderzuiger. Drie afdichtringen zijn verantwoordelijk voor het afdichten van de drukruimte: twee in de onderzuiger en één in de bovenzuiger.
1. Onderzuiger
2. Afdichtring (onderzuiger)
3. U-cupafdichtring - ROOD (onderzuiger)
4. U-cupafdichtring - BLAUW (bovenzuiger)
5. Bovenzuiger / filterkop
Heet water komt de cilinder binnen (via de onderzuiger) tussen de twee afdichtringen in de zuiger. De mix van water en koffiepoeder wordt door het gaas in de bovenzuiger gefilterd en verlaat vervolgens de cilinder. De afdichting in de bovenzuiger en de onderzuiger moeten tijdens het brewingproces bestand zijn tegen de druk van heet water (10 bar). De vorm van de u- cupring (3) voorkomt krassen in de cilinder door koffiekorrels. De bovenste afdichtring (2) hoeft niet bestand te zijn tegen hoge druk, maar is slechts een schraapring.

title: Calibrate the brewer / water flow meter
text: The water flow meter (water counter) measures the amount of water and is calibrated in the factory. When the water flow meter is replaced, it needs to be calibrated once. The system needs to 'know' how much water is entering the brewer and how to position the needle in the flow regulator to make sure the amount of water is correct. Check the procedure in the Calibrations (see Calibration of Water flow meter on page 125) section for more details.

title: Replace the flow regulator
text:
Purpose
There is no need to replace the flow regulator. Regular cleaning of the machine will keep the flow regulator clean and working properly. Replace only if requested by the service department.

• Philips screwdriver

title: Remove the flow regulator
text:
Procedure
1. Remove the CoEx XL brewer from the machine.
2. Remove the cover from the brewer.
3. Make sure the brewer is clean. ▪ Clean with warm water (a mild detergent may be added) and make sure to remove any leftover coffee grains.
4. Remove the screw (A) that secures the outlet support (C).
5. Loosen the flexible connections (B) and remove the outlet support.
6. Remove the two screws (A) from the flow regulator (B).
7. Lift the spindle end (A) from the brewer frame. ▪ If needed, rotate the spindle end first to release it from the brewer frame.
▪ Unlock the spindle gear (B) from the guide (C).
8. Slide and lift the flow regulator (D) from the regulator pipe (E) where it connects to the filter.
9. Pull the spindle gear (A) away from the flow regulator (B) until the needle (C) is visible.
10. Turn the spindle gear (A) 180° -in either direction- and unlock it from the needle (B).

title: Install a new flow regulator
text:
1. Use the new flow regulator (C) and connect the spindle gear (A) to the needle (B).
2. Turn the spindle gear (A) 180° -in either direction- to lock it to the needle (B).
3. Push the spindle gear (A) into the regulator (C) and check that the spindle gear is locked to the needle (B) as shown in the picture.
▪ Note that the needle locking is visible.
4. Pump the spindle gear in and out a few times to make sure the needle in the flow regulator can move freely.
5. Position the spindle gear (A) under the inlet water hose (B) first.
6. Insert the flow regulator (C) in the regulator pipe (D).
7. Insert the spindle end (E) in the frame at the back of the brewer.
▪ Rotate the spindle end, if needed, to adjust the length and fit it in the frame.
8. Push down the middle of the spindle gear (A) to lock it in the guide (F) inside the frame.
9. Secure the flow regulator (A) with two screws (B). ▪ Do not tighten the screws too hard.
10. Connect the two flexible connections (A) of the outlet support (B) to the flow regulator (C) and secure with one screw (D).
11. The replacement is finished.
12. Place the cover on the brewer and install the brewer in the machine.

title: Test the flow regulator
text:
1. Place the service key.
2. Login in the Service Menu.
3. Tap the [HARDWARE] button.
4. Make sure the waste bucket is completely dry. ▪ During execution of the test recipe in the next step, check for water in the waste bucket.
5. Tap the [Test espresso recipe] button. ▪ Check that:
a. no water leaks in the waste bucket during execution of the test recipe.
b. at the end of the recipe, the needle moves to the flush position and releases a small amount of water. This amount of water is visible in the waste bucket.

title: Ingredient canisters
text:
The canisters are provided with a metal or plastic auger. The metal auger is used for instant coffee, instant tea and leaf tea.
The plastic auger is used for the other ingredients. Special augers are available for special ingredients or low gram throws.
All canisters are driven by a 24VDC 120RPM motor.

title: D-grinder
text: 4.3.1 D-grinder

title: General
text:
The D-grinder uses high performance grinder discs that give a consistent grind and operates at about twice the speed of the Schaerer grinder to grind beans for coffee and espresso. This means that the same amount of ground coffee is created in half the time. Check the specifications at the end of this chapter for more details. The D-grinder is easy to clean and settings (like grinding degree) are maintained when the grinder is opened for cleaning. The grinding degree of the D-grinder is not measured in pins and teeth but displayed in an indicator window on the grinder. The indicator shows a scale from 0 to 12 (actual degrees divided by 10). The D-grinder is set to a default grinding degree of 6 in the factory. Note that the type of beans used and (local) flavor expectations may require a different setting of the grinder in the coffee machine.
1. Auger 10. Grinder motor drive
2. Grinder house top assembly 11. Grinding degree adjustment screw
3. Upper grinding disc (stationary) 12. Grinding degree scale window
4. Screws upper grinding disc 13. Grinder adjustment cover
5. Screws lower grinding disc 14. Screws worm wheel assembly
6. Lower grinding disc (rotating) 15. Adjustment wheel
7. Grinder base / Motor cover 16. Grinder outlet
8. Grinder stand 17. Drive shaft
9. Grinder house 18. Grinding disc assembly bottom
The grinder unit consists of the top assembly (2) that contains the stationary –non moving- upper grinding disc (3). The top assembly is secured to the grinder house using a bayonet catch for easy access. The grinder house (9) contains the bottom assembly with the rotating lower grinding disc (6). By adjusting the lower grinding disc up and down, the air gap between the two grinder discs can be set very accurately. The gap between the two grinder discs determines the grain size of the ground coffee also known as the grinding degree. The grinding degree is set manually by rotating the adjustment wheel (15) with an adjustment screw (11). This screw is accessible when the grinder is installed in the coffee machine. The adjustment wheel contains a grinding degree scale that is visible through a small window (12). A 24-volt motor in the grinder base powers the lower grinding disc via a gear box to the drive shaft (17).

title: Change the grinding degree
text:
The grinding degree can be adjusted without removing the grinder from the coffee machine.
The actual grinding degree is visible in a small indicator window in the bottom left of the grinder.
1. Adjust the grinding degree with the (Philips type) screw, accessible on the bottom right of the grinder base.
▪ Turn left (+) for a coarser grinding / higher number.
▪ Turn right (-) for a finer grinding / lower number.
▪ Turn the screw in the desired direction and check the indicator to see the current grinding degree.
Set the grinding degree to the value 6 (factory default) or to the preferred value that was already known.
70
Avy CEC Medium Cabinet 7000/9000 CoEx® brewer Technical Manual 5DTCET20M EN V1.2
Take a test beverage to test for taste and write down the finally set grinding degree for future reference.
The outer areas of the scale are marked in red (values lower than 1.5 and higher than 10.5).
This is only needed once (or when installing a new grinder or new grinder discs).

title: Clean the grinder
text:
Regular (monthly) cleaning of the grinder is recommended to prevent clogging of old ground coffee inside the grinder house.
Also, burned beans and ‘foreign’ objects (like wood or stones) can block the grinder and need to be removed.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Remove the grinder from the machine.
2. Open the grinder house.
72
Avy CEC Medium Cabinet 7000/9000 CoEx® brewer Technical Manual 5DTCET20M EN V1.2
3. Clean the grinder discs and the inside of the grinder house (do not forget to clean the gap around the discs).
4. Close the grinder house.
5. Install the grinder in the machine.

title: Replace the grinder discs
text:
The upper and lower discs are identical.
The screws in the lower and the upper disc are NOT identical.
Required tools
• Philips screwdriver
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Remove the grinder from the machine.
2. Remove the grinder outlet. ▪ spread the two fixation clips (1) that secure the outlet to the grinder.
▪ slide the outlet in the direction of the arrow (2) and remove it from the grinder.
3. Remove the grinder house top assembly. ▪ Turn the cover of the top assembly in the direction of the arrow (clockwise!) to unlock the bayonet catch and remove the top assembly from the grinder.
74
Avy CEC Medium Cabinet 7000/9000 CoEx® brewer Technical Manual 5DTCET20M EN V1.2
4. Remove screws from upper grinding disc.
5. Remove the upper disc.
6. Before placing the new upper grinding disc make sure that the mounting surface is clean.
7. Place the upper grinder disc.
8. Secure the upper disc with three screws.
Tighten the screws gently, but firmly.
9. Loosen and remove the three screws in the lower disc.
76
Avy CEC Medium Cabinet 7000/9000 CoEx® brewer Technical Manual 5DTCET20M EN V1.2
10. Remove the lower disc.
11. Clean up the grinder house and make sure that the mounting surface for the lower grinding disc is clean (to prevent a different grinding degree).
12. Place the new lower grinding disc.
13. Secure the lower grinding disc with three screws.
Tighten the screws gently, but firmly.
14. Close the grinder house. ▪ Install grinder house top assembly.
▪ Place the grinder house top assembly on top of the grinder and turn it in the direction of the arrow (counter clockwise!) to close and lock it to the grinder house.
15. Install grinder outlet. ▪ Slide the grinder outlet in the direction of the arrow on the outside of the grinder house and make sure the locking clips of the outlet lock properly.

title: Readjust the D-grinder
text:
The D-grinder has been set in the factory to the default grinding degree of 6, this number corresponds to a gap between the two grinder discs of about 0.25 mm.
Readjustment is possible if this number, shown in the little window on the grinder, does not match with the actual gap between the grinder discs. This can happen :
• when new grinder discs are installed.
• after the initial break-in period of the grinder discs (after grinding beans for 1000 cups of coffee).
Required tools
• Torx 20 screwdriver
78
Avy CEC Medium Cabinet 7000/9000 CoEx® brewer Technical Manual 5DTCET20M EN V1.2
Procedure
Perform the following steps
1. Remove the adjustment cover. ▪ Bend the four locking clips (1) in the direction of the arrows and pull the adjustment cover (2) from the grinder house.
2. Remove the screws that secure the adjustment wheel. ▪ Pull the adjustment wheel from the drive shaft in the direction of the arrow. The adjustment disc is now visible.
3. To be able to turn the adjustment disc, insert two screws and give them a few turns.
4. Turn the adjustment disc gently in the direction of the arrow until the two grinding discs touch each other.
5. Check that the drive shaft cannot be turned anymore. ▪ The grinder discs are now reset to 0 (zero).
6. Remove the two support screws from the adjustment disc. ▪ Make sure not to change the current position of the adjustment disc.
80
Avy CEC Medium Cabinet 7000/9000 CoEx® brewer Technical Manual 5DTCET20M EN V1.2
7. Slide the adjustment wheel onto the drive shaft. The adjustment wheel contains a restrictor (1) that fits in a slot on the outside of the grinder house (2). The restriction slot limits the rotation of the adjustment wheel to 120º.
▪ Push the adjustment wheel down the shaft and turn it clockwise until the restrictor is in the left corner of the slot of the grinder house.
8. A second check: make sure that the number 0 of the scale on the adjustment wheel is positioned above the small vertical mark in the outside of the grinder house near the grinder outlet.
9. Secure the adjustment wheel with three screws. ▪ Tighten the screws gently but firmly.
10. Place the cover. The numbers 1 and 2 are embossed on the bottom outside of the adjustment cover. Position the number 1 in line with the grinder outlet. Position the number 2 in line with the grinder outlet for a grinder in door only.
▪ Slide the adjustment cover in the direction of the arrows and make sure that the four clips lock properly to the ledges on the outside of the grinder house.
11. The readjustment is now finished. Continue with the section Grinding degree (see Change the grinding degree on page 70) to set the grinder to the preferred grinding degree that was already noted down.

title: Mixer
text:
The mixer consists of a mixer motor, a mixer propeller and a mixer house. The mixer is controlled by the control board and ensures a correct mixing of the ingredient(s) and water. By the rotation of the mixer propeller, air is mixed with the water and ingredient(s) and a foam layer is formed. This will improve the taste and the appearance of the consumption.
Motor specification: 24VDC, 14.000 RPM. In case of a blockage, a safety is actuated on the IO board and the message “mixer blocked” is shown in the screen.
A restricted inlet diameter of the mixer house is used to create a nice flow in the mixer bowl.

Remove the canister plate bean canister
Perform the following steps:

3. Install the bean canister - Place the bean canister on the grinder base and push the canister lock in the direction of the arrow.

title: Ingredient canisters
text:
The canisters are provided with a metal or plastic auger. The metal auger is used for instant coffee, instant tea and leaf tea.
The plastic auger is used for the other ingredients. Special augers are available for special ingredients or low gram throws.
All canisters are driven by a 24VDC 120RPM motor.

title: Bekersensor
text:
De bekersensor detecteert een beker op het bekerplateau. Er kunnen maximaal twee bekersensoren op de machine worden aangesloten. Een voor de rechter en een voor de linker uitlaat.
Een beker moet op de juiste positie op het bekerplateau worden geplaatst voordat de startknop beschikbaar is en de cyclus kan beginnen. De gevoeligheid van de sensor is in te stellen via het servicemenu, zie Bekersensor (op pagina 112).
PCB bekersensor (alle kleine en medium modellen)
De sensorbehuizing kan, afhankelijk van het machinetype, variëren. Zie voor meer informatie de handleidingen voor reserveonderdelen.

title: Cup sensor
text:
The cup sensor senses a cup on the cup stand. One PCB, containing two cup sensors, is connected in the machine. One for the left and one for the center outlet.
A cup must be placed on the correct position on the cup stand before the start button is available and the cycle can start. The sensitivity of the sensor is adjustable in the Service Menu section Cup sensor (on page 117) settings.
Cup sensor PCB (Nio models)

title: Cup dispensing
text:
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Place a cup under the correct outlet. ▪check the drawing of the front view (on page 15) for the
correct outlet.
2. Tap the desired beverage button from the selections on the Main menu (see on page 20).
▪or first tap one of the [Scroll left/right] arrow buttons to
show other beverages in the current category.
▪or first select the desired [Category] to show the available
beverages in that category.
3. The Additional Options (see on page 23) submenu with the selected beverage is shown.
4. When available and needed, tap one or more of the desired options to make additional changes.
5. Tap the [Order] button to prepare the beverage. ▪or tap the [Home] button to return to the Main menu (see
on page 20).
▪when payment mode is activated, full payment is needed
first to enable the [Order] button. Check the payment (on page 39) section for more details.
6. The Dispense submenu (see on page 30) is now shown and the beverage is prepared.
▪tap the [Stop] button to interrupt and stop the dispense.
7. When the dispense is finished the Ready submenu (on page 31) is shown. ▪do not remove your cup before the message 'Ready, take
your cup (see Message: Ready, take your cup on page 91)' is visible. The message will remain visible on the screen until the cup is removed.
▪to add an additional beverage to the same cup, do not
remove the cup but tap the [Back] button and select the next beverage.
8. The prepared drink is ready.

title: Jug dispensing
text:
Purpose
When configured it is possible to fill complete jugs at once.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
When hot liquid comes in contact with a person, this can lead to serious scalding injuries.
1. Remove the cup stand from the magnetic suspension point in the door.
2. For hot (or cold water - optional) water place the jug on the right side below the hot water outlet.
3. For all other dispenses place the jug in the middle below the main outlet.
4. If the jug submenu is not visible tap the [Jug] button from the main menu (see Main menu - Cup dispensing on page 20).
5. Tap the desired beverage and jug filling from the shown selection buttons.
▪or tap the [Cup mode] button to return to the Main menu
6. Tap the [Order] button to start the dispense. ▪if the coffee machine is configured with a Canister
selection bar, it is possible to select a different canister.
Tap the desired choice.
▪tap the [Cancel] button to return to the Main menu (see
Main menu - Cup dispensing on page 20).
▪when payment mode is activated, full payment is needed
first to enable the [Order] button. Check the payment (on page 39) section for more details.
▪if the [Order] button is disabled, check the Message area
for more details.
7. The Dispense submenu (see Dispense submenu on page 30) is now displayed.
▪tap the [Stop] button to interrupt and stop the dispense.
8. When the dispense is finished the Ready submenu (on page 31) is shown. ▪do not remove your cup/jug until the message "Ready,
take your cup (see Message: Ready, take your cup on page 91)" is shown.
▪the message will remain visible on the screen until the
cup/jug is removed.
▪to add an additional beverage to the same cup/jug tap the
[Cancel] button.
9. The filled jug is ready.
10. Place the cup stand back in the magnetic suspension point in the door.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
38

text: 5.6 Preventive maintenance procedures

title: Switch on
text:
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Turn on the water supply.
2. Connect the power cord to an earthed power socket.
3. Open the door (on page 44).
4. Switch the [ON/OFF] power switch to the ON position. ▪check the drawing of the inside view (on page 16) for the
precise location.
5. Close the door (on page 44).
6. The coffee machine will start up.
7. The main screen is displayed with the message 'Filling boiler' and then 'Heating boilers' in the User message area (see Additional options submenu on page 23).
8. After a few minutes the message 'Heating boilers' disappears and the machine is ready for use.

title: Open or close top lid
text:
Purpose
To fill up or clean the canisters they need to be removed from the coffee machine. To allow easy access to the canisters, the top lid of the coffee machine can be opened.
Procedure
Perform one of the following steps:
1. To open, lift the top lid in the front and swing it open to the back. The top lid stays open in the upright position.
2. To close, swing the opened top lid back down. Make sure it is lowered completely and locks when the door is closed.

text:

1. Open the door (on page 44).
2. Switch the [ON/OFF] power switch to the OFF position. ▪check the drawing of the inside view (on page 16) for the
precise location.

▪perform daily maintenance (on page 42) or, if the machine
is not used for a longer time, it is recommended to perform monthly maintenance (on page 43).
▪turn off the water supply.
▪switch off the power supply (pulling the plug from the wall
socket is sufficient). This will also prevent unnecessary use of energy.

title: Scheduled rinse
text:
Purpose
Cleaning the coffee machine can be skipped or forgotten. The scheduled rinse is forced every day using a scheduler. When activated follow the procedure below to perform the rinse.
Instead you can also run the daily maintenance (on page 42) or weekly maintenance (on page 42).
Required
Use the following parts to perform the procedure:
• A rinsing tub or 1 liter jug
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• Daily (see Daily maintenance on page 42), announced on screen
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Place a rinsing tub or jug under the outlet nozzle to collect the rinse water.
2. Tap the button [Place cup and press here] on the screen. ▪Hot water from the boiler flows through the mixers and
brewer.
3. A progress screen is shown. ▪Wait until the rinse procedure is finished.
▪Total time to rinse is 1 to 2 minutes.
4. Remove the rinsing tub.
5. The machine returns to the Main menu (see Main menu - Cup dispensing on page 20) and is ready for use.

title: Clean waste bucket
text:
Purpose
After every dispense, coffee residue (the coffee cake) is moved into the waste bucket. Excess water from the brewer is captured in a drip bucket, placed inside the waste bucket (B). If an external waste bin is used, the waste bucket is replaced by a waste guide (G) in combination with a larger waste water bucket or a fixed connection to the waste water drain. All parts need to be emptied and cleaned regularly.
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• Daily (see Daily maintenance on page 42).
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Flip up the dispense arm with the outlet nozzles.
2. Depending on the used bucket types: ▪B) Remove the waste bucket (with the drip bucket inside
it) from the machine, or
▪G) Remove the waste guide and water bucket from the
machine.
3. Rinse the removed parts with clean warm water.
4. Dry parts completely.
5. Install the waste buckets: ▪B) Place the drip bucket inside the waste bucket and
install both inside the machine, or
▪G) Place the water bucket on the right side and the waste
guide on the left side in the machine.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
48
6. Flip down the dispense arm to the normal position.

title: Clean the mixing system
text:
Purpose
To prevent clogging of ingredients the mixers must be removed from the coffee machine and cleaned.
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• Weekly (see Weekly maintenance on page 42), increase the frequency if needed
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
52
1. Remove the outlet hoses from the mixers.
2. Remove the canister outlets and remember the correct position and location of each outlet.
3. Turn the bayonet catches counterclockwise (approx. 10º).
4. Pull the mixer houses in the direction of the arrow and remove them from the machine.
5. Pull the mixer propellers in the direction of the arrow and away from the shaft.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
54
6. Turn the bayonet catches counterclockwise (approx. 10º) again to release and pull them in the direction of the arrow away from the machine.
7. Pull the exhaust filter drawer in the direction of the arrow and remove it from the machine.
8. Remove the exhaust filter from the drawer.
9. Rinse out all removed parts of the mixing system with clean warm water.
▪Make sure to clean the inside of the hoses with a hose
cleaning brush and pay attention to inside corners in the hoses.
10. Clean the parts of the mixing system that remain in the machine with a brush.
11. Before continuing with the installation of the mixing system make sure ALL parts are dry.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
56
12. Insert the mixer exhaust filter in the filter drawer.
13. Install the filter drawer.
14. Install the bayonet catches and turn clockwise (approx. 10º).
15. Install the mixer propellers.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
58
16. Install the mixer houses.
17. Turn the bayonet catches clockwise to lock the mixer houses.
18. Install the canister outlets on the canisters and make sure the locations and positions are correct.
19. Connect the outlet hoses to the mixers.

13. Install the filter drawer.

60

16. Install the mixer houses.

18. Install the canister outlets on the canisters and make sure the locations and positions are correct.

title: Remove and clean the brewer
text:
Purpose
For cleaning with water, the brewer must be removed from the coffee machine. The brewer mounting frame needs to be checked and cleaned to prevent malfunctioning of the brewer.
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• At least once a week (see Weekly maintenance on page 42), increase the frequency if needed.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
60
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Open the door (on page 44), the Service menu is displayed.
2. In the Service menu, tap the [Manual Brewer Cleaning] button.
▪Follow the Manual Brewer Cleaning instructions shown on-
screen and described in the next steps.
3. Place the service key in the door.
4. Tap the [Next] button. ▪The brewer will be placed in the manual cleaning position.
Wait until the position is set and the message 'The CoEx XL brewer is now ready for manual cleaning' is shown.
5. Remove the service key.
6. Remove the coffee outlet and hose from the dispense arm and clean with warm water.
▪Make sure to clean the inside of the hoses with a hose
cleaning brush and pay attention to inside corners in the hoses.
7. Remove the brewer from the coffee machine: place four fingers in the lower grip (1). With your thumb, push and hold down the locking grip (2) and pull the brewer from the mounting frame in the direction of the arrow (3).
8. Place the brewer on a flat surface. Locate the cover release marks on the sides of the brewer cover (see inset). Pull the sides, near these release marks, a few millimeters away from the brewer and lift the cover from the brewer.
9. Clean the brewer with clean warm water (a mild detergent may be used).
10. Place the cover on top of the brewer and push down. Make sure all sides lock.
11. Make sure the inside of the brewer mounting frame in the coffee machine is clean.
12. Insert the brewer into the mounting frame and push the brewer in the direction of the arrow (1) until it locks. Make sure the locking grip (shown in green in the picture) is not pushed in anymore.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
62
13. Install the coffee outlet nozzle in the dispense arm and connect the hose to the connector on the brewer mounting frame.
14. In the Service menu, tap the [Done] button to finish the procedure.

title: Remove and clean the brewer
text:
Purpose
Removal of the brewer is necessary for performing the cleaning procedure.
Required
Use the following parts to perform the procedure:
• Blue brewer key
• Green service key
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• At least once a week (see Weekly maintenance on page 47), increase the frequency if needed.
Instructions for performing work on the brewer itself is found in the technical manual.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Tear off the filter paper on the left and right of the brewer.
2. Insert the service key (on page 88) in the door.
3. In the Service menu tap the [Replace filter paper] button. ▪The brewer chamber will move up to the open position.
4. Remove the service key (on page 89) from the door.
5. Remove the brewer chamber by pulling it in the direction of the arrow.
6. Remove the remaining old filter paper from the brewer.
▪Lift the transport wheels with the cantilever if needed.
7. Remove the nozzle / outlet pipe from the brewer.
ROSA FND Small Cabinet 2000 Filterfresh® User Manual 5DUFNV20M EN V2.3
66
8. Take the brewer out of the machine. First tilt the lower part of the brewer towards you to release the main shaft from the motor interlocking.
▪Tilting the lower part about 10 cm is enough.
9. Lift the brewer a little to release the studs from the suspension and remove the brewer from the coffee machine.
10. Rinse the brewer with clean warm water.
11. Before installing, make sure the brewer chamber is still in the open position.
▪If needed, adjust the position of the main shaft to fit the
motor interlocking.
12. Place the studs at the back of the brewer in both suspension holes.
13. Lower the brewer down and make sure that the main shaft fits the motor interlocking.
▪Some force is needed to lock the brewer properly.
14. Place the nozzle / outlet pipe on the brewer.
ROSA FND Small Cabinet 2000 Filterfresh® User Manual 5DUFNV20M EN V2.3
68
15. Guide the filter paper through the brewer, lift the transport wheels with the cantilever if needed.
▪for details, see section Place new filter paper (on page
74).
16. Install the brewer chamber. Press the brewer chamber with the two pins into position.
17. Insert the service key (on page 88) in the door.
18. In the Service menu tap the [Replace filter paper] button. ▪This will move the brewer through a cycle. Check if the
filter paper is being transported properly and runs smoothly.

title: Remove and clean the brewer
text:
Purpose
For full cleaning with water, the brewer must be removed from the coffee machine. The brewer bracket must be checked and cleaned to prevent malfunctioning of the brewer.
Required
Use the following parts to perform the procedure:
• Pipe brush cleaner.
• Hose cleaning brush.
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• At least weekly (see Weekly maintenance on page 42), increase the frequency if needed
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Loosen the brewer outlet from the brewer together with the connecting hose and outlet nozzle.
2. Locate the fixation handle on the brewer.
Virtu CEC Medium Cabinet 70/90 CoEx® brewer User Manual 5DUCEK20I EN V2.3
64
3. Push the fixation handle upwards and, while keeping the handle in the upward position, pull and lift the brewer in the direction of the arrow out of the coffee machine.
4. Make sure the brewer bracket in the coffee machine is clean; clean the water connection (A) and the motor coupling (B).
5. Rinse the brewer and the other removed parts with clean warm water.
▪Make sure to clean the inside of all hoses with the hose
cleaning brush and pay extra attention to the corners inside the hoses.
6. Remove any residue inside the brewer outlet pipes with a small pipe brush cleaner.
7. Place the brewer on the bracket and push the brewer firmly in the bracket until you hear a click.
▪Make sure that the fixation handle is in the down position.
Virtu CEC Medium Cabinet 70/90 CoEx® brewer User Manual 5DUCEK20I EN V2.3
66
8. Install the brewer outlet with the outlet hose. ▪To prevent leaking make sure the CoEx outlet (see inset) is
pushed completely on the outlet pipes of the brewer head.

title: Clean brewer with cleaning tablet
text:
Purpose
Cleaning of the brewer with a cleaning tablet removes all coffee residue. The brewer remains in the coffee machine.
Required
Use the following parts to perform the procedure:
• Cleaning tablet.
• Rinsing tub or 1 liter jug.
• Protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses.
• Green service key.
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• At least once a week (see Weekly maintenance on page 42), increase the frequency if needed.
• Total time for the cleaning cycle is 8 minutes.
• A message is shown if the brewer is not cleaned after 7 days.
• A message is shown and coffee dispense is disabled if the brewer is not cleaned after 9 days.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Open the door (on page 44), the Service menu is displayed.
2. In the Service menu, tap the [Brewer Cleaning] button. ▪Follow the Brewer Cleaning instructions shown on-screen
and described in the next steps.
3. Place a 1-liter jug or a rinsing tub under the outlet.
4. Insert the service key (on page 81) in the door.
5. Tap the [Next] button. ▪The first part of the brewer cleaning procedure starts, wait
until the rinse is finished.
6. Tap the [Next] button to place the brewer in the correct position.
7. Wait until the next steps are shown.
8. Drop a cleaning tablet in the brewer.
9. Tap the [Next] button to continue the cleaning procedure. ▪Wait until the cleaning cycle is completely finished (about
8 minutes) and the final part of the procedure is shown.
Repeat the full cleaning procedure if the cleaning cycle is not completely finished.
10. Tap the [Done] button to finish the procedure.
11. Remove the service key (on page 82) from the door.
12. Remove and empty the rinsing tub.

title: Unblock the grinder
text:
Purpose
Occasionally small twigs or small rocks (known as foreign objects) are in between the fresh beans. The grinder will stop if these objects are blocking the grinder. A message 'Grinder blocked' (see Message: Grinder blocked on page 85) is displayed in the warning message area.
Procedure
To unblock the grinder perform the following steps:
1. Locate the grinder that needs cleaning up.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
64
2. Remove the canister to get access to the grinder.
75) for details about the removal of the canisters.
When the canister is removed, the grinder itself is visible.
3. To clean the grinder, lift and remove the grinder from the base.
4. Pull out the clips (1) of the grinder outlet, slide the outlet (2) from the grinder house and remove it from the grinder.
5. Loosen the bayonet locked grinder house top in the direction of the arrow and remove it from the grinder.
6. Clean both grinder discs and the inside of the grinder house.
7. Place the grinder house top assembly, and turn it in the direction of the arrow to lock.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
66
8. Slide the outlet on the grinder house in the direction of the arrow.
▪Make sure the clips lock properly.
9. Place the grinder back into the grinder base.
10. Place the canister back.
11. Close the door (on page 44) and lock with the key.
12. Leave the Service menu.
13. Check correct functioning by taking a test coffee.

release it from the bottom fixation of the bracket.

and make sure it locks properly in position.
8. Insert the hose in the dispenser arm.

title: Fill up the cup dispenser — optional
text:
Purpose
Follow this procedure when the machine contains a cup dispenser. In order to prevent that the machine can no longer dispense drinks due to a lack of cups, the machine must be refilled in time.
Required

• Paper or plastic cups for coffee machines (diameter 70 mm or 73 mm).
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• When needed.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Open the door (on page 45) of the machine.
2. On the inside of the door flip up the locking lever of the cup dispenser door.
3. Open the cup dispenser door.
Virtu CEC Medium Cabinet 70/90 CoEx® brewer User Manual 5DUCEK20I EN V2.3
74
4. Place the new cups in the dispenser door. ▪A maximum of three stacks of cups is possible. Start filling
with the stack on the right side.
5. To prevent damage to the cups do not stack them higher then the top support plate. Remove all cups visible above the support plate.
6. Close and lock the dispenser door.

▪Lift the transport wheels with the cantilever if needed.

74

11. Check if the filter paper is being transported correctly and that no folds or creases are in the paper.
12. Remove the service key (on page 89) from the door.
13. Check the functioning of the machine by taking a test drink (coffee).

title: Clean the canisters
text:
Purpose
All ingredients leave residue inside the canister. To clean the canisters they need to be removed from the machine.
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• Monthly (see Monthly maintenance on page 43), increase the frequency if needed
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Open the door (on page 44).
2. Open the top lid (see Open or close top lid on page 45) of the coffee machine.
3. Remove the canisters from the machine. ▪Check the first steps in the section Fill up the ingredient
canisters (on page 72) for more details about the removal of the canisters.
4. Unlock (optional) and remove the lid from the canisters.
5. Empty the canisters.
6. Clean the canisters with warm water.
7. Dry the canisters thoroughly on the inside and outside.
The product may form lumps which makes the system unusable.

title: Clean the cold water outlet nozzle — optional
text:
Purpose
The cold water outlet nozzle must be cleaned regularly to prevent bacteria growth.
Required
Use the following parts to perform the procedure:
• Multi purpose, disposable cloth.
• Cleaning agent.
• Disposable paper towels.
• Rinsing tub or 1 liter jug.
• Protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses.
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• Weekly (see Weekly maintenance on page 42), increase the frequency if needed (depending on machine usage and environmental conditions)
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3

1. Use the cloth to apply the cleaning agent. Submerge a clean cloth into the cleaning agent (concentration recommended by cleaning agent manufacturer’s instructions). Remove the cloth and remove excess water.

3. Rinse the cloth in clean warm water and wipe off excess cleaning agent residue and soil.

6. Place a rinse tub below the cold water outlet nozzle.

8. Select a full jug of cold water and dispense at least 1 liter of cold water and ensure any cleaning residue is flushed out.

title: Deep clean the cold water outlet nozzle — optional
text:
Purpose
The cold water outlet nozzle must be cleaned and disinfected regularly to prevent bacteria growth.
Required
Use the following parts to perform the procedure:
• Multi purpose, disposable cloth.
• Cleaning agent.
• Protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses.
• Disinfectant solution.
• Disposable paper towels.
• Rinsing tub or 1 liter jug.
• Brush.
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• Monthly (see Monthly maintenance on page 43), increase the frequency if needed (depending on machine usage and environmental conditions)
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Submerge a clean cloth in warm water. Pre clean the cold water outlet nozzle using the cloth.
2. Submerge a clean cloth into the cleaning agent (concentration recommended by cleaning agent manufacturer’s instructions). Remove the cloth and remove excess water.
3. Clean the cold water outlet nozzle wiping the cloth over the entire area re-submerging the cloth as necessary.
4. Using a brush, brush around the cold water nozzle to dislodge any dried on soil. Remove the soil with a cloth.
5. Soak a clean disposable cloth in clean warm water and rinse the outlet nozzle until all soil and cleaning agent residues are removed.
6. Soak a clean disposable cloth in disinfectant solution, ensure that the whole area is wiped.
7. Leave for 10 minutes.
8. Rinse off disinfectant using disposable cloth in clean warm water.
9. Dry cold water nozzle with disposable paper towels.
10. Close the door (on page 44) of the coffee machine.
11. Place a rinse tub below the cold water outlet nozzle.
12. Leave the Service menu: Tap the [Exit] button and then the [OK] button to answer the question 'Do you want to leave the service menu' to leave the Service menu.
13. Select a full jug of cold water and dispense at least 1 liter of cold water and ensure any cleaning residue is flushed out.

title: Fill up the ingredient canisters
text:
NOTE
• Make sure that the canisters remain filled with a layer of at least 4 cm of product.
• Only use ingredients recommended by the supplier of the machine.
• To fill up a bean canister (optional) check the section Fill the bean canister.
Purpose
To prevent that the machine can no longer dispense drinks due to a lack of ingredients, the machine must be refilled in time.
Required
Use the following to perform the procedure:
• Ingredients.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Open the door (on page 44).
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3

2. Open the top lid (see Open or close top lid on page 45) of the coffee machine.

4. Slightly lift the canister at the front until the small locking ridge (see inset) is visible.
5. Pull the canister towards you and take it out of the machine.
6. Remove the lid and place the canister on a stable surface.
7. Fill the canister with the ingredient indicated on the canister.
8. Place the lid back on the canister and position the canister back into the machine.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
74
9. Turn the outlets of the canister downwards.
10. Close the top lid (see Open or close top lid on page 45) of the machine.

text:

• Coffee beans.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Open the door (on page 44).
2. Open the top lid (see Open or close top lid on page 45) of the coffee machine.
3. Locate the canister locking slider in between the grinder and the bean canister.
4. Pull the canister locking slider in the direction of the arrow. The bean canister will be closed and unlocked from the grinder base.
5. Lift the bean canister from the grinder base and take it out of the machine.
6. Place the bean canister on a stable and flat surface for refilling.
7. Unlock the lid (optional). Lift the lid in the front and then pull the lid from the canister in the direction of the arrow.
8. Fill the canister with fresh coffee beans.

76
9. Place the back side of the lid on the canister and then lower the front side. Lock the lid (optional).
10. Place the bean canister back into the coffee machine on the four position ridges of the grinder base.
11. Push the canister locking slider back in the direction of the arrow to open the bean canister and secure it to the grinder base.
12. Repeat the procedure if more bean canisters must be filled up.

title: Enter canister ingredient levels — optional
text:
Purpose
When activated the coffee machine displays a message 'Canister % almost empty' when the ingredient canisters are almost empty.
Based on the number of beverages taken, the machine calculates the amount of ingredients left in the canisters. When the canisters are filled up the counters need to be reset. Follow the steps in the procedure below to reset the counters.
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• When this option is active, the Enter ingredient level screen is displayed when the door is opened.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. When the door is opened, the Enter ingredients levels screen is displayed.
▪The current fill level of each canister is displayed (only the
fill levels of the canisters activated for this option are shown).
2. To change a canister fill level, first tap the [Edit fill levels] button (A) on the screen.
▪or tap the [Exit] button to leave the Service menu.
Avy XEA Medium Cabinet 190:00 CoEx XL® brewer User Manual 5DUXET20M EN V2.3
78
3. Fill level sliders are shown for each activated canister. Tap the level or move the slider to the correct fill level.
4. Repeat the previous step for each canister that is filled up (or where the shown value is not correct).
5. Tap the [Save fill levels] button (B) to save the current setting.
6. Tap [Exit] to leave the Service menu.

• When this option is active, the Enter ingredient level screen is displayed when the door is opened.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. When the door is opened, the Enter ingredients levels screen is displayed.
▪The current fill level of each canister is displayed (only the
fill levels of the canisters activated for this option are shown).
2. To change a canister fill level, first tap the [Edit fill levels] button (A) on the screen.
▪or tap the [Exit] button to leave the Service menu.
3. Fill level sliders are shown for each activated canister. Tap the level or move the slider to the correct fill level.
4. Repeat the previous step for each canister that is filled up (or where the shown value is not correct).
5. Tap the [Save fill levels] button (B) to save the current setting.
6. Tap [Exit] to leave the Service menu.

title: Fill up the bean canister
text:
NOTE
• Make sure that the canisters remain filled with a layer of at least 1.6 in of product.
• Only use ingredients recommended by the supplier of the machine.
• To fill up an ingredient canister (optional) check the section Fill up the ingredient canisters (on page 80).
Purpose
In order to prevent that the machine can no longer dispense drinks due to a lack of ingredients, the machine must be refilled in time.
Required
Use the following to perform the procedure:
• Coffee beans.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Open the door (on page 45).
2. Open the top lid (see Open or close top lid on page 46) of the coffee machine.
3. Locate the canister locking slider in between the grinder and the bean canister.
4. Pull the canister locking slider in the direction of the arrow. The bean canister will be closed and unlocked from the grinder base.
5. Lift the bean canister from the grinder base and take it out of the machine.
6. Place the bean canister on a stable and flat surface for refilling.
7. Unlock the lid (optional). Lift the lid in the front and then pull the lid from the canister in the direction of the arrow.
8. Fill the canister with fresh coffee beans.
Virtu CEC Medium Cabinet 70/90 CoEx® brewer User Manual 5DUCEK20I EN V2.3
84
9. Place the back side of the lid on the canister and then lower the front side. Lock the lid (optional).
10. Place the bean canister back into the coffee machine on the four position ridges of the grinder base.
11. Push the canister locking slider back in the direction of the arrow to open the bean canister and secure it to the grinder base.
12. Repeat the procedure if more bean canisters must be filled up.

title: Clean the touchscreen — optional
text:
Purpose
The touchscreen is the main interface between user and coffee machine. To ensure a hygienic and flawless use, the touchscreen must be cleaned regularly.
Required
Use the following parts to perform the procedure:
• A clean soft cloth for disinfection purposes.
• (Isopropyl) alcohol.
Interval
Perform this procedure:
• At least daily (see Daily maintenance on page 42).
• When announced on screen.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Tap one of the buttons with the message [PRESS here to start cleaning]. The screen will be switched off now.
▪or tap [Cancel] to return to the Main menu.
- Cup dispensing (on page 20) to see the location).
Instead you can also open the door of the machine.
The Service menu is now shown. Tap the [Shiny hand] in the top of the screen. The available time to clean the screen is shown with a countdown timer.
2. Clean the touchscreen with some (Isopropyl) alcohol on a clean soft cloth.
CAUTION
- Do not use any other (aggressive) chemicals to clean the surface of the touchscreen.
- Prevent dripping, do not use too much cleaning liquid on the cloth.
3. After some time, the touchscreen is switched on again. The machine returns to the Main menu and is ready for use.

title: The service key
text:
Purpose
For safety reasons all dispense functions are disabled if the door of the machine is opened. Use the green service key to override this safety for maintenance procedures that need a fully functioning machine.

title: Insert the service key
text:
Required
Use the following parts to perform the procedure:
• Green service key.
Procedure
Perform the following steps:
1. Locate the entry for the Service key on the inside of the door.
2. Insert the Service key in the service key entry.
3. Turn the Service key a quarter turn (90°). ▪The grey options in the Service menu change to yellow/
green.
▪The coffee machine is now fully functional with an open
door.
▪The key remains locked in the entry.
